description: A short label or hint on an element, shown when the pointer rests on it or it gets keyboard focus, and on a touch screen by a tap on plain text or a long press on a button, above the finger; hidden on Esc. On any side, moving to the other when there's no room, and never clipped by a table or a modal. Read out by screen readers as the element's description. Works inside Livewire components.
